# Bundled iTerm2 Themes

These `.itermcolors` files are vendored for the Shiki-to-iTerm theme mappings in [`nu-doc-gen/themes.nuon`](../../themes.nuon).

Upstream source:

- <https://github.com/mbadolato/iTerm2-Color-Schemes>

The generated doc site uses these palettes to derive the surrounding site color variables for the selected `--light-theme` and `--dark-theme` pair.
